name: RELAY
tagline: Keep each application’s facts, wording, and history together.
summary: Relay is a private, human-reviewed workspace for carrying job context between assistants and keeping an application record current.
capabilities: Keep one owner-scoped record per job, with research and application history kept together.
Import selected tracker rows or job research as evidence; imports do not accept wording or overwrite current application state.
Maintain candidate facts that you confirm yourself. For a prompt or file handoff, include only facts relevant to that job.
Return assistant-written wording to the same job. Relay checks the job version and refuses stale saves.
Review and accept exact wording yourself. Editing accepted text requires fresh acceptance.

Update application state yourself. In the fictional fixture, the included Chrome operative can record Submitted when it reports a receipt. Relay does not independently verify what the employer received.
A separate application action requires human Inspect approval before an external browser receives a one-use permit. Relay itself does not POST the employer form.

integrations.name: ChatGPT
integrations.description: Prepare a selected-job handoff, then return the assistant's draft for review.

integrations.name: Codex
integrations.description: Use the same handoff or the local CLI adapter with a signed-in Codex CLI.

integrations.name: Obsidian
integrations.description: Exchange selected job research and version-bound draft files.

integrations.name: Notion
integrations.description: Import selected research through a local read-only command.

integrations.name: Claude
integrations.description: Prepare an external draft with your own API credentials.

integrations.name: Grok Bot
integrations.description: Exchange research and drafts through explicit file or local command handoffs.

integrations.name: Tracker CSV
integrations.description: Map columns, preview selected rows, then import them as research.

integrations.name: Chrome operative
integrations.description: Optional unpacked extension for the fictional fixture; not a real ATS adapter.

boundary: Assistants can prepare drafts from context the person chooses to share. They cannot confirm facts, accept wording, or infer permission to act. Accepting wording records approval of that exact text; it grants no permission to submit. Relay does not independently verify draft claims or assess qualifications.
openaiBoundary: ChatGPT uses a prompt and file handoff; Codex also supports a local CLI adapter. Relay does not provide a hosted ChatGPT app or hosted MCP connection.
